summary.headline: Conjunctions, Full Moons, and Inceptions
summary.text: Astrological doctrine on the Moon’s moist nature, swift motion, changing activity after conjunction and full moon, and influence on ocean tides. The section “On conjunctions and full moons; on inceptions” gives rules involving malefics, the Bad Daemon, planetary lords, signs, borrowing and lending, presidencies, exile, and violent death, with a cross-reference to codex 7, folio 152v.
